title: Season Two Episode 2 Expertise Goes Global
author: Rebecca Birch
summary: Educational expertise is increasingly global as educators connect across borders through platforms like podcasts and online communities. The episode explores how expertise in teaching and pedagogy transcends national boundaries and how teachers worldwide share learning science insights. This globalization of education creates opportunities for teachers everywhere to access world-class pedagogical thinking and participate in international conversations about student learning.
points: Expertise in education is no longer geographically bound—teachers can access and contribute to global conversations about pedagogy
Podcast and digital platforms enable direct connection between education researchers and classroom practitioners worldwide
International teaching communities accelerate the spread of evidence-based instructional practices
Global knowledge sharing creates a rising tide of pedagogical quality across different educational systems
Teachers worldwide benefit from exposure to diverse approaches and evidence-based methods across cultures
